base: Scientific educational 3D fitness library image exactly 1536x1024 landscape, same style as user reference. FACELESS GRAY athletic mannequin, no hair/human skin color. Intact BLACK clothing: male full tank covering entire chest/abdomen and shorts, female complete sports bra and shorts; black shoes. TWO equal panels with thin WHITE vertical line at center. LEFT INITIAL and RIGHT FINAL phases described below. SAME fixed three-quarter viewpoint, identical equipment orientation/scale, full body, feet/hands and all equipment inside each panel with 5% margins. Clean dark CHARCOAL studio ground/background; no text, labels, extra people, arrows or distracting objects. Only necessary exercise equipment. Worked muscle bellies and fine directional fibers anatomically visible in RED as translucent overlay over INTACT clothes/gray skin. Red AND fiber detail fade smoothly together to transparent in ALL directions with broad feathered gradients, NO hard outlines/cutoffs, no clothing removed, no exposed anatomy/nipples. Keep full shorts fabric intact: glute/quadriceps overlays go over cloth without cutting it away. Highlight only specified prime movers, arms/chest stay gray unless specified. Realistic wrapped fingers/thumbs and neutral wrists, mechanically connected equipment, anatomically coherent joints.
specs: sentadilla

BODYWEIGHT SQUAT, no weights/equipment. Left stand feet shoulder width toes slightly out; right squat thighs near parallel, hips back, knees track toes, heels and full feet planted, neutral spine. Arms forward for balance. Quads and glutes red. Camera front-side three-quarter.
prensa-de-piernas

45-DEGREE SLED LEG PRESS MACHINE. Reclined seat supports head/back/pelvis, hands on side handles. Both feet flat shoulder width on large angled sled footplate, knees track toes. Left knees flexed about90deg with sled near torso and lower back supported; right push sled UP rails with legs nearly straight without knee lock. Same plate/rails/seat geometry, feet never float or switch positions, safety handles visible. Quads/glutes red.
extension-de-piernas

SEATED MACHINE LEG EXTENSION. Proper knee extension machine, back and buttocks on seat, knees aligned machine pivot, horizontal roller on FRONT LOWER SHINS just above ankles, hands side handles. Left knees bent90deg lower legs down; right extend BOTH knees to nearly horizontal lower legs, thighs remain fixed on seat. Roller rotates with shins, always contacting front ankles. Quadriceps ONLY red, not hamstrings.
zancada

BODYWEIGHT FORWARD LUNGE. Left stand upright feet hip width hands hips. Right step one foot forward and lower into lunge, front knee90deg tracks toes, front full foot planted, rear heel raised toes planted rear knee near floor. Neutral torso, no twisting, same camera. Quads and glutes red, no equipment.
curl-de-pierna-tumbado-en-maquina-de-femoral

PRONE LYING LEG CURL MACHINE. Lie face DOWN with chest/abdomen/pelvis/thighs supported on angled padded bench, head neutral, hands front handles. Machine roller behind LOWER CALVES just above heels, knees aligned pivot. Left knees nearly extended; right flex BOTH knees90deg drawing roller up toward buttocks, thighs/hips remain on pad. Mechanically consistent lever/roller contact. HAMSTRINGS posterior thighs primary red and subtle gastrocnemius. Rear-side three-quarter camera shows posterior thighs.
sentadilla-hack

HACK SQUAT MACHINE with angled sliding sled. Head/back/buttocks against sled pad, shoulders under TWO padded shoulder rests, hands on handles beside shoulders; both feet flat on angled platform. Left near-standing knees soft, right knees/hips flex90deg lowering sled along same rails, heels planted, knees track toes. Machine NOT bodyweight squat. Quads/glutes red. Side-front three-quarter.
extension-a-una-pierna

SINGLE-LEG SEATED MACHINE KNEE EXTENSION. Proper seated extension machine, supported back/hips, knee aligned pivot. Near working leg roller at FRONT lower shin above ankle. Left working knee90deg lower leg down; right ONLY working knee extends near horizontal lifting roller. Other foot remains relaxed down supported same position, not extending. Thigh stays fixed, hands handles. Working QUADRICEPS red only, roller connected lever.
sentadilla-frontal

BARBELL FRONT SQUAT. Straight bar with modest equal plates rests across FRONT deltoids/clavicle shelf not neck. Clean front-rack grip fingertips under bar slightly wider shoulder width, elbows HIGH forward throughout. Left stand, right squat hips/knees flex thighs parallel, torso upright neutral spine, feet full planted shoulder width knees track toes. Bar remains on front shoulders, not behind neck or held in air. Quads/glutes red.
peso-muerto-rumano-con-mancuernas

DUMBBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Two dumbbells, one per hand neutral grips in front-side of thighs. Left upright hips extended knees softly bent. Right HINGE hips BACK, torso inclines forward neutral spine, knees retain small bend (not squat), dumbbells travel CLOSE to legs down to mid-shin, arms hang straight. Feet stationary planted, head aligned spine. HAMSTRINGS and GLUTES red, posterior-side camera.
peso-muerto-rumano-con-barra

BARBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Straight loaded bar double OVERHAND shoulder-width grip, no mixed grip. Left stand bar at thighs soft knees. Right hips pushed BACK with flat neutral back, torso nearly horizontal, slight knee bend maintained, bar descends close along thighs/shins to mid-shin, arms straight. Not squat or rounded back, feet planted same spots. HAMSTRINGS/glutes red posterior-side viewpoint.
sentadilla-goblet-con-mancuerna

GOBLET DUMBBELL SQUAT. ONE dumbbell held VERTICALLY at chest, both palms cup underside of UPPER dumbbell head, fingers secure, lower end hangs, elbows point down. Left stand shoulder-width toes out slightly; right deep comfortable squat thighs parallel torso upright neutral, knees track toes and heels down. Weight remains against chest, not held overhead. Quads/glutes red.
salto-rodillas-al-pecho

BODYWEIGHT TUCK JUMP. Left ready standing soft knees, arms back preparing jump, feet hip width on floor. Right AIRBORNE with visible clearance under shoes, BOTH knees drawn toward chest hips/knees flexed, torso fairly upright, arms forward for balance, no grabbing legs or sitting on invisible surface. Same camera. Quads/glutes/calves softly red, subtle hip flexors. No equipment.
burpees

BURPEE key start/end phases. Left INITIAL LOW PLANK chest near floor, palms flat shoulder width, legs straight back toes on floor, elbows bent45deg, body aligned head-hips-heels. Right FINAL VERTICAL JUMP at same ground area, torso upright arms straight overhead, hips/knees extended, both feet off floor with modest clearance. Full fingers/feet in frame. Quads/glutes/calves primary red plus subtle pectorals/triceps on left, broad soft fade. No equipment.
sentadillas-con-propio-peso

STANDARD BODYWEIGHT SQUAT no equipment. Left upright stance feet shoulder width toes slightly outward arms relaxed. Right squat knees/hips flex thighs parallel, hips back, knees track toes, heels flat, arms forward chest height, neutral head/spine. Same viewpoint and foot positions. Quads/glutes red.
sentadillas-con-balon-medicinal

MEDICINE BALL SQUAT. ONE round medicine ball held securely against chest with both palms on sides, elbows down, fingers realistic. Left upright; right squat hips back knees tracking toes, thighs parallel, full feet planted. Ball stays at chest same orientation, no throwing. Quads/glutes red.
sentadilla-bulgara-con-barra

BARBELL BULGARIAN SPLIT SQUAT. Barbell modest equal plates across UPPER BACK TRAPS below neck, hands wide overhand wrapped. Rear foot TOP rests on padded flat bench behind, front foot full planted well forward. Left split stance near-straight front knee; right lower hips vertically front knee90deg, rear knee toward floor, front heel stays planted, chest slight forward neutral spine. Same foot/bench contacts in both. Front quads/glutes red. Side three-quarter.
sentadilla-bulgara-con-propio-peso

BODYWEIGHT BULGARIAN SPLIT SQUAT. Rear foot instep supported on padded bench behind, front foot full planted forward, hands hips. Left near extended front leg; right bend front knee90deg lowering rear knee toward ground, torso neutral slightly forward. Foot contacts remain identical, no bar/weights. Front quads/glutes red.
sentadilla-con-minibanda

MINIBAND SQUAT. Closed small resistance loop around BOTH thighs just ABOVE KNEES (not around ankles), stays visible continuous. Left stand shoulder width band slightly taut, right squat thighs parallel pushing knees outward in line toes to resist band, heels down hips back torso neutral. Hands clasped at chest. Quads/glutes especially glute medius red, band never disappears.
sentadilla-con-salto

SQUAT JUMP. Left bottom preparatory squat thighs near parallel heels planted arms behind/at chest, torso neutral. Right airborne vertical extension, hips/knees nearly straight ankles extended feet clear floor, arms reaching up for jump. Same viewpoint, whole arms/feet visible. Quads/glutes/calves red.
sentadilla-isometrica-apoyado-sobre-la-pared

WALL SIT. Minimal single plain vertical wall needed behind mannequin, rest background empty. Left stands BACK against wall, feet placed forward, hands at sides. Right slides down to seated HOLD with back/pelvis against wall, knees90deg, thighs horizontal, shins vertical, feet planted shoulder width, hands relaxed not pushing knees. No chair. QUADS red primary, glutes subtle. Same side three-quarter wall/feet.
peso-muerto-con-balon-medicinal

MEDICINE BALL DEADLIFT. Both hands hold ONE medicine ball in front close to thighs. Left standing upright ball at hips arms straight; right hinge hips backward with knees modestly bent and neutral back, ball descends between/near shins, arms straight, full feet planted. Not overhead lift or squat. HAMSTRINGS/glutes red posterior-side camera.
peso-muerto-a-una-pierna

BODYWEIGHT SINGLE-LEG ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Left stands on near leg soft knee, other foot lightly off floor arms relaxed. Right hinge over supporting hip, torso and lifted rear leg extend into straight horizontal line, supporting knee remains softly bent, pelvis square not rotated, free leg goes BACK not to side, arms reach down for balance. No weights. Working hamstrings/glutes red. Same side three-quarter.
sentadilla-sumo-con-kettlebell

SUMO KETTLEBELL SQUAT. Wide stance toes outward30deg, both hands overhand around ONE kettlebell handle, weight hanging between legs, arms straight. Left upright; right squat hips down knees wide track toes, heels planted torso neutral, kettlebell lowers vertically between legs without ground collision. Quads/glutes/ADDUCTORS inner thighs red.
buenos-dias-con-barra

BARBELL GOOD MORNING. Modest equal plates bar rests upper-back traps BELOW NECK, hands wide overhand secure. Left upright soft knees. Right hinge hips BACK with knees same slight bend, flat neutral back torso forward near horizontal, bar stays supported on upper back (not pulled in hands). Feet stationary hip width. Hamstrings/glutes and subtle spinal erectors red, no chest red. Side three-quarter.
puente-con-propio-peso

BODYWEIGHT GLUTE BRIDGE FLOOR. Left supine back and hips on ground, knees bent90deg feet flat hip width, arms at sides palms down. Right lift hips until shoulders-hips-knees straight diagonal, shoulders/head stay on floor, knees track toes, no lumbar hyperextension. Feet and shoulder contacts unchanged. GLUTES primary red over intact shorts, hamstrings subtle. Side three-quarter.
puentes-a-una-pierna

SINGLE LEG GLUTE BRIDGE. Supine head/shoulders on floor, near working foot flat knee bent, far leg extended diagonally upward same position both phases. Left hips low on ground; right working foot presses floor lifting hips to align shoulder-hip-working knee, pelvis level, no arch. Free leg remains straight not assisting on floor. Glute/hamstrings supporting leg red. Side camera.
puente-con-bandas

BANDED GLUTE BRIDGE floor. Closed miniband around thighs above knees, knees hip width pressing slightly outward throughout. Left supine hips on floor knees bent feet flat, arms down. Right hips lift shoulder-hip-knee straight line, head/shoulders stay grounded no lumbar arch. Continuous visible band in both panels. Glute max/medius red over full shorts, hamstrings subtle.
caminata-de-pato

DUCK WALK in low squat, no equipment. Left deep comfortable squat knees bent hips low heels near floor, torso neutral angled forward hands clasped chest. Right remains LOW squat while one foot takes small step forward, hips maintain same low level, knees track toes. Show clear shifted leading foot, no standing/jumping or duck animal. Quads/glutes red. Same fixed side three-quarter.
superman-en-cuadrupedia

QUADRUPED BIRD DOG (Superman en cuadrupedia). Left hands under shoulders knees under hips on floor, flat neutral back head looking down. Right extend near ARM FORWARD and OPPOSITE LEG BACK to torso height, palm faces inward, heel pushes back, hips/shoulders remain square, other hand/knee firmly grounded. No back arch. Glute of extended leg plus subtle spinal erectors and core softly red overlay, arm gray. Side three-quarter.
groiners

GROINERS dynamic low lunge from plank. Left high plank palms flat under shoulders legs extended back toes down. Right ONE foot steps forward to OUTSIDE same-side hand, front knee bent aligned toes, rear leg straight toes planted, both palms stay on floor same spots, torso neutral no contortion. Quads/glutes/adductors/hip flexors softly red, not arms. Same side three-quarter.
hidrantes

FIRE HYDRANT quadruped hip abduction. Left all fours hands under shoulders knees under hips knees90deg, neutral back/pelvis. Right near leg knee stays bent90deg and lifts OUT TO SIDE to about hip height, foot follows knee, pelvis level not rotating; other knee and both palms stay grounded. Glute MEDIUS lateral hip red over intact shorts, subtle glute max. Rear three-quarter camera reveals lateral lift and all supports.
elevaciones-de-cadera-con-maquina-smith

SMITH MACHINE HIP THRUST. Upper back/scapulae against horizontal bench behind, padded Smith bar across HIP CREASE not abdomen, hands stabilize bar outside hips, bar attached both ends to vertical guide rails. Feet flat shoulder width in front. Left hips lowered knees bent; right extend hips until torso horizontal shoulder-hip-knee line, shins vertical and chin slightly tucked, upper back remains supported same bench contact. No lumbar arch. Glutes red, hamstrings secondary. Same side three-quarter visible bar pad/rails.
abducciones-de-cadera-sentado-con-banda

SEATED BANDED HIP ABDUCTION. Seated front of flat bench torso upright slightly forward, feet flat, closed miniband around thighs above knees. Left knees hip width band lightly taut; right spread knees outward with feet still planted same heels, band stretches continuously, no standing or foot lift. Glute MEDIUS lateral hips red over intact shorts, no quads emphasis. Front three-quarter camera.
abduccion-de-cadera-en-maquina

SEATED HIP ABDUCTION MACHINE. Back/hips supported seat, hands side handles, feet on machine footrests, pads against OUTER thighs just above knees. Left knees closer together; right spread thighs/knees OUTWARD against pads while feet travel with linked footrests. Both pads remain outside contacting outer thighs, no inward squeeze. Glute MEDIUS lateral hips red over full shorts. Front three-quarter machine joints consistent.
abduccion-con-polea

STANDING CABLE HIP ABDUCTION. Low pulley tower at mannequin far side, padded ANKLE CUFF on working near leg visibly clipped to taut cable running down to floor pulley, supporting hand on tower for balance. Left stand legs close working foot near ground. Right working straight leg lifts OUTWARD to side30deg away from tower, knee soft, pelvis level torso upright no leaning, supporting foot planted SAME spot. Cuff stays ankle, cable never through body. Glute medius lateral hip red. Front three-quarter.
elevaciones-en-posicion-de-rana

FROG PUMP GLUTE BRIDGE on floor. Supine head/shoulders on ground, soles of feet pressed TOGETHER with knees falling outward in butterfly position, heels close to buttocks. Left hips low; right lift pelvis by glutes to align shoulders-hips-knees as comfortable, knees stay outward and SOLES TOGETHER, shoulders grounded no arch. Arms palms floor. Glutes red over intact shorts, adductors subtle. Side-front three-quarter shows joined soles.
elevaciones-cortas-en-posicion-de-rana-con-maquina-smith

SMITH MACHINE FROG PUMP short-range hip lift on FLOOR. Supine head/shoulders on floor, knees bent OPEN outward butterfly, SOLES OF FEET TOGETHER, padded Smith bar across hip crease held stable hands outside hips, bar ends attached vertical rails. Left hips low; right short hip lift about15-20cm, glutes contracted, head/shoulders remain grounded soles still together knees open. No bench, no normal feet-apart hip thrust. Glutes red, full shorts intact, show all rails/pad safely.
almejas-laterales-con-banda

SIDE LYING BANDED CLAMSHELL. Lie on side head supported by lower forearm, hips stacked, knees bent90deg in front, feet stacked TOGETHER. Closed miniband around thighs above knees. Left knees closed touching; right TOP KNEE opens upward30-45deg while FEET STAY touching and pelvis remains stacked no rolling back, bottom leg grounded. Upper hand on floor in front chest. Glute MEDIUS upper lateral hip red over full shorts. Same side-front camera.
levantamiento-de-pierna-acostado-de-lado

SIDE LYING STRAIGHT LEG RAISE. Lie on side head resting supported lower forearm, hips stacked, lower leg slightly bent for stability, TOP LEG straight toes forward slightly down. Left upper leg rests above lower leg; right lift same straight top leg30-40deg upward WITHOUT rotating pelvis or externally turning toes, bottom leg/forearm and supporting upper palm unchanged. Glute medius upper hip red, no band/equipment. Same side camera.
step-up-con-mancuernas

DUMBBELL STEP UP. Sturdy rectangular exercise box about knee height, two dumbbells held securely at sides neutral grips arms straight. Left one FULL front foot atop box knee90deg, rear foot on floor. Right drive through top foot extend working hip/knee standing atop box, trailing foot lifts to join or hover alongside, no jumping, torso neutral upright. Full foot/box contact visible, dumbbells never intersect box. Working quads/glutes red. Same side three-quarter.
caminata-lateral-con-minibanda

LATERAL MINIBAND WALK. Closed loop around BOTH thighs just above knees, shallow quarter squat knees tracking toes, torso neutral hands clasped chest. Left feet hip width band taut; right one foot steps laterally outward widening stance while hips maintain same shallow squat level and other foot stays planted. Toes forward, no inward knee collapse, band visibly stretches continuous. Glute medius lateral hips red, quads subtle. Front three-quarter.
elevaciones-de-rodilla

STANDING HIGH KNEE RAISE. No equipment. Left upright both feet planted hip width arms bent relaxed. Right near leg hip flexes lifting knee to waist height90deg, supporting leg straight soft knee foot planted, torso upright no crunch/back lean, opposite arm forward natural marching. No airborne jump. Hip flexors anterior hip and rectus femoris front thigh red fading over intact shorts and skin, no whole abdomen red. Side three-quarter.
columpios-con-kettlebell

TWO-HAND RUSSIAN KETTLEBELL SWING. Both hands overhand wrapped around ONE kettlebell handle, straight arms. Left backswing: hip HINGE hips back slight knee bend, neutral spine, bell passes high BETWEEN thighs, never through body, heels planted. Right finish: hips/knees extended upright, bell floats at CHEST/SHOULDER HEIGHT with arms forward nearly horizontal, not overhead, no squat/arm curl, no lumbar hyperextension. Hamstrings/glutes primary red, subtle core. Side three-quarter.
contragolpe-con-cable

STANDING CABLE GLUTE KICKBACK. Low pulley tower IN FRONT, both hands grip frame for balance, torso tilted slightly forward neutral back, working near ANKLE secured in padded CUFF visibly clipped to taut cable floor pulley. Left feet near each other working foot slightly off floor; right extend same working leg BACK from hip about25deg keeping knee slightly bent, pelvis square no lumbar arch, supporting foot fixed. Cuff remains ankle and cable continuous no body intersection. Glute max working leg red, hamstrings secondary. Side three-quarter.
patadas-de-burro

DONKEY KICK quadruped. Left hands under shoulders knees under hips on floor neutral back, both knees90deg. Right near leg keeps knee BENT90deg and extends BACK/UP until THIGH parallel torso and sole faces ceiling, not leg out sideways, pelvis level no lumbar arch. Both hands/other knee stay grounded same spots. Glute MAX working side red over intact shorts, hamstrings subtle. Side-rear three-quarter.
